end of heading, About Vira Health, level 1

We started in 2020 with the mission to provide high-quality menopause care. Since then, we have have broadened our offering to cover all life stages across women’s and men’s health. We now support one million people through information, support and clinical care.

We partner with some of the world’s leading public and private healthcare companies and multinational employers. We are here to support all health needs so they can age well, including bone, brain, and heart health.

“We created Vira Health because most people do not have access to the health care they deserve. Our ambition is to provide the best clinical care, access to specialists, educational resources and community support. People can face health challenges at all life stages, including fertility, pregnancy, postpartum, parenting and hormonal health conditions. This is why we expanded our support to help patients and employees live their happiest, healthiest and most productive lives now and in the future.”
Andrea and Rebecca, Founders of Vira Health
